releaseNotes: Notes Pro now shows only settings relevant to the selected tool
Pen mode shows pen style, thickness and pen colors only
Marker mode shows marker colors, width and opacity only
Text mode adds font family, font size, text color, bold, italic, underline and alignment
Added text presets for Title, Body and Quote plus bullet list, checklist and highlight background helpers
Text formatting is stored per positioned text block so mixed handwriting and formatted text remain on the same page
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
